conditions.displayName: Cloud Run log entry with severity ERROR or higher

documentation.content:
A Cloud Run service wrote a log entry with severity ERROR or higher.

This is a log-match alert, not an Error Reporting "new error group" alert: the Monitoring API offers no condition for new Error Reporting groups, so every error log is matched, limited to one notification per 60 minutes.

**First look:** open the cloud0 **Errors** tab and use the triage view to see which service, status code and message dominate, then open the sample in **Logs Explorer** (resource type `Cloud Run Revision`, filter on the service named in the incident).
